entry_points.text: Swapoff validates privilege, resolves file to active device by backing mapping, refuses hibernation-pinned or under-reserved devices, detaches from availability and active with counter fix, drains allocations, reclaims with restartable scan, tears down references, flushes work, releases extents and clusters, clears marking and flags, notifies poll waiters, restoring on reclaim failure.

Swapon validates flags and privilege, obtains reusable descriptor, opens exclusively, records block or file backing, rejects invalid files, requires folio read, loads header to size device, builds extents and clusters and marks stable and synchronous behavior.

Cross-subsystem helpers cover single-slot duplication with owner validation, throttling, compressed-store registration sized from total pages, and boot init caching arch maximum, creating reclaimable table cache and enabling migration support past bit-derived threshold.

Globally visible look-around scans PTEs in PMD-VMA intersection capped to bounded batch around fault address, clears young with notifier awareness, skips single-page spans and special mappings, coalesces same-folio entries tracking dirtiness, reports each folio once and feeds back to bloom filter when young density warrants revisit.

Sysfs exposes TTL milliseconds converted to and from jiffies with strict parsing, and enable mask reporting core, walker and nonleaf as small hex; writes accept leading N none, Y all or unsigned mask; core bit drives migration, other bits toggle capabilities.

Sequential read iterates groups and nodes with path buffer, printing memcg, node and per-generation lines in brief or full window with zone sizes and below-minimum markers; write takes separated commands with op, memcg, node, generation, swappiness and options, validates node and memcg, defaults swappiness with anon bound, runs aging or eviction in bounded batches until target, progress or signal under reclaim, no-reclaim, plugging and walker context.

exports.text: Compressed swap tables are sized from total pages, initialized and published per type on registration; teardown tolerates absence but warns on survivors before releasing storage and clearing count.
Swap size bound derives from encodable offset range via soft-leaf conversion; arch hook defaults to generic computation and bounds later header validation.

hazards.text: Reclaim hazards: signals abort long scans; memory pressure reinserts entries requiring retry; racing cache removal needs stale-only cleanup after writeback wait under folio guard; concurrent proc readers need stable type and ordered publication; out-of-range generation warns and concurrent isolation returns negative via missing bits.

Activation and teardown hazards: hibernation pin refuses off; encrypted, large-folio and zoned devices refuse on; missing dup owner warns once plus rate-limited diagnostic with invalid-argument result; area-discard errors report without aborting while store and drain failures abort before exposure; swap-cache races mitigated by reference kill, grace wait and completion barrier; cleanup nulls released cluster state.

Walk and command hazards: absent tables, huge-zero markers, notifier-disabled fast clear, wrap and truncation, latency and batch resume, contended-lock abandonment, excluded copy-on-write mappings, large-folio batched evaluation, invalid nodes and memcg ids, out-of-range swappiness, future or too-recent sequences, interrupted eviction, and user-copy and allocation failure.

invariants.text: Reclaim scans shared objects then address spaces from global list then residual cache by forward scan; per-space cover is anonymous non-huge regions under read guard with stable-layout check, yields periodically, aborts on signal, repeats until usage vanishes with barrier before teardown.

Swapon checks flags and privilege, reuses descriptor, opens exclusively, rejects unlinked, unmountable, active, encrypted or large-folio files, requires folio read, validates header for size, builds extents and clusters, records default or preferred priority with negated ordering keys plus solid versus rotating and discard capabilities.

Allocation prefers lowest reusable slot with ordered publication for proc readers and initializes root, nodes, flags, guards and completion; lifetime uses killed reference revived on activation and killed plus grace wait on deactivation, with per-CPU cluster caches invalidated by atomic replacement.

Extents use single cover for block devices or filesystem or generic builders for files; clusters size from capacity with per-cluster guards, premark header, bad and trailing slots, partition free versus nonfull with rotating-only global cluster; claim rejects zoned sequential-write devices; process list drains only after global zero usage.

Proc presentation holds filesystem mutex, skips fileless slots, prints header plus per-device partition or file lines with capacity, usage and priority, with poll via sampled event counter; status counts usable devices from global atomic plus estimate for used but not yet writable.
Usable swap is non-empty active ordering; throttling is skipped without IO allowance, usable swap, congestion, or when caller already throttles, else first block-backed available device is asked.

List reclaim clears active, groups same-node folios, reclaims with write, unmap and swap but no demotion, returns leftovers without nested reclaim; demotion tries target node-local first; slab drop iterates groups and nodes with growing threshold, aborting on fatal signal; writeback wakes queue past allowance; mapping removal returns size on detach else zero.

Generation update skips isolated folios, marks first-touch non-exec file referenced without promotion, else atomically installs next generation with workingset flag; batch accounting moves counts between generation buckets; keys split pointer hash by twice shift with vacuous pass and set-missing update when filter exists; scan needs young density of one per cache line over clamped factor.

VMA scan excludes inaccessible, huge, non-recency, locked, special, gate, anon and shmem without swappiness, unevictable or overswappiness file, and no-read-folio entries; leaf helpers need present young-or-notifier entries with node, group and generation match; iteration aligns, bounds and clamps; nonleaf clear needs arch plus gate; zero selects minimum, low values maximum.

Huge-PMD batching arms on first address, sets bitmap for nearby offsets, flushes on distant address or terminator under best-effort trylock with gated young clear; PMD walk visits PTE tables locklessly first with bloom gating and found versus added stats; PUD walk descends present non-leaf, delegates subranges, truncates at boundary on scheduling need or batch limit, distinguishing completion from resume with next-address cursor.

Eligibility uses memcg state, sizability, swappiness minimum, birth time and TTL; aging walks groups on one node with fast path or trylock OOM in kswapd context; display expands generations by tier and type with refault and walker stats; init checks spacing, warns on sysfs failure, creates brief and full entries.

locks.text: Activation and deactivation nest global guard outside per-device guard; priority uses dedicated mutex; flags clear under global spin; inode held across registration and drain; proc traversal holds filesystem mutex; process-list walk uses global guard with handoff; cluster guards serialize allocation.

Allocation drain requires write permission cleared then briefly takes each cluster guard in order to await in-flight users; cluster release takes each guard to assert emptiness before freeing table and container.
Status holds global guard while iterating slots; throttle scan uses availability guard only after cheap checks pass to avoid ordering contention.

Table walks never sleep: PMD flush uses trylock and abandons on failure; look-around needs page-table lock and bails when contended; leaf walk proceeds only on trylock with recheck and batched updates; migration holds per-lruvec IRQ lock per batch; enable nests cgroup, CPU, memory then state mutex; OOM uses trylock.

state_machines.text: Activation moves allocated reusable descriptor through file validation, header sizing, extent and cluster build, optional area discard, compressed-store registration, swap marking with write drain, to published state joining active and availability lists with grown counters; pre-publish failure unwinds in reverse with deregistration, extent and cluster release, flag clear, rotation fix and file release.

Deactivation moves active through detached yet reclaimable to drained and unusable to released; reclaim failure restores to active, else proceeds via reference kill, grace wait, work flush, extent and cluster release to cleared flags ready for reuse.

Per-lruvec generation mode is boolean with strict list invariant: enabled requires classic lists empty, disabled requires generation lists empty; enabling and disabling flip global switch and core capability then migrate in bounded batches with rescheduling; other capabilities toggle independently; re-requesting current mode is no-op.

Pageout distinguishes keep-locked, activate-locked, unlock-after-dispatch and clean-locked; folio references distinguish reclaim, keep and activate; scan balance distinguishes equal, fractional, anon-only and file-only.

structs.text: Swap descriptor tracks type, priority, flags, capacity, usable count, backing file, block device and operations, extent root, active and availability nodes, free, full and discard plus per-order nonfull and fragment lists, global cluster pointer with guard, cluster table, usage, reference and completion, and discard and reclaim work items.

On-disk header carries magic, version with endian handling, last-page marker, bad-page count with bounded list; cluster entry carries guard, usage, flags, linkage and allocation table; bad, header and tail slots premarked before lists build.

Reclaim control carries targets, masks, group targeting, anon and file costs, swappiness override, packed deactivation, permission, low-memory and mode bits, order, aggressiveness, allocation mask, progress and stall counters, and slab state; feedback position holds refaulted and total plus signed gain.
Controls are two read-write attributes under one sysfs group, a four-function sequential iterator, and two file-operation sets sharing open, read, seek and release where only read-write adds write.

ABI: deactivation 1 anon, 2 file; swappiness 60; bloom shift 15; LRU switch false; log prefix adds module name; tracing via creation macro; memcg-LRU five-valued none, head, tail, old, young; sysfs group with TTL and enable plus brief read-write and full read-only debug entries.

Swap ABI: versioned header with signature, last page and bad list, endian handling, clamping to arch and file bounds; proc columns with poll semantics; standard failures for privilege, argument, busy, memory, interruption and missing file.
